fusions.name: Venom Sippers
fusions.desc: Three rats dart ahead of you, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each bite deals 10% more for every affliction on its target (max 30%).

fusions.name: Siphoned Sickness
fusions.desc: Bites out every affliction you have on the target: it deals 16 damage, with 60% more for each affliction used up, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. The target is left 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cough It Up
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Outlived the Dose
fusions.desc: As one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 8% poison resistance.
